question: Should ClawHub change published skill licenses from a uniform MIT-0 platform contract to a mixed MIT/MIT-0 contract based on package.json or LICENSE metadata, and should existing latest versions be repaired by the summary backfill?
rationale: Current main and prior discussion encode fixed MIT-0, while this PR intentionally changes public storage/API/docs/UI semantics and needs maintainer/legal policy confirmation before merge.

options.title: Approve mixed MIT/MIT-0 with backfill
options.body: Land the branch only after real behavior proof and a clear operator plan for repairing existing MIT-declared versions.

options.title: Narrow to future versions
options.body: Allow MIT detection for new publishes/imports but do not claim existing versions are fixed until a separate migration or maintenance run is approved.

options.title: Reaffirm fixed MIT-0
options.body: Close or pause this PR and update the linked issue with the maintained platform-license policy.

recommendation.title: Approve mixed MIT/MIT-0 with backfill
recommendation.body: Land the branch only after real behavior proof and a clear operator plan for repairing existing MIT-declared versions.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete made the prior fixed MIT-0 product-direction call on the related license metadata PR and is the strongest history-backed owner for deciding whether that policy changes.
